payload.title: Session handoff and overnight-summary files are committed in docs/archive of the public repo
payload.description:
**Problem**
docs/archive/streams-and-rendering-sessions/ holds 14 agent session files in the public repository. They are working notes, not documentation, and contain phrases like "as requested".

**Evidence**
Files on main: ALTERNATIVE_STREAMS_APPROACH.md, DYNAMODB_STREAMS_SOLUTION.md, ECS_INFRASTRUCTURE_COMPLETE.md, HANDOFF.md, MORNING_CHECK.md, OVERNIGHT_SUMMARY.txt, RENDERING_MODES_STATUS.md, SESSION-FILES-CHANGED.md, SESSION-SUMMARY.md, START_HERE.md, STREAMS_README.md, STREAMS_STATUS.md, TESTING_RENDERING_MODES.md, VERIFY_STREAMS_DEPLOYMENT.md.

**Fix**
Delete the folder, or fold anything worth keeping into proper docs. History keeps the originals.

**How to verify**
`ls docs/archive/streams-and-rendering-sessions` fails (directory gone) on main.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
